## Type of change

- [ ] `docs` — new or changed case/playbook content
- [ ] `fix` — correction of a wrong or inconsistent statement
- [ ] `refactor` / `style` — restructuring or formatting, no change of meaning
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling and maintenance

## Consistency checklist

- [ ] **Requirement traceability:** new or changed design statements trace to a requirement ID (or N/A)
- [ ] **ADR needed?** A decision changed or was added → ADR added or updated in `case-01-example-corp/02-options-decisions/adr/` (or N/A)
- [ ] **Consistent with existing documents:** requirements ↔ HLD ↔ ADRs ↔ risk register ↔ estimate still agree (inconsistencies listed below)
- [ ] Duration and cost figures are labelled *illustrative*

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes (markdownlint, link and anchor check, gitleaks)
- [ ] Every Mermaid diagram renders
- [ ] No real company names, domains, IPs, hostnames, people or credentials in the diff
- [ ] Links to other repositories are absolute URLs, never relative paths
